authority: This is the single private wire contract. Rust types are src-rs/core/src/multiview/broker/wire.rs. Earlier private-api-proposal.json is superseded.
example_notice: Synthetic identities and zero hash only; not operational credentials.

pairing.provisioning: Operator provisions a separate credential out of band. Never reuse control-server bearer or trust discovery as enrollment. Origin is exact verified HTTPS for LAN. server_epoch is learned only after authenticated capabilities; a changed epoch invalidates sessions.
pairing.server_record: Server owns subject, installation_id, credential revision, expiry, exact permissions and allowed sources. Native cannot supply those authority fields. Native credentials have multiview-control only; source enrollment requires separate sources-manage operator.
pairing.bind: Default loopback. LAN bind requires explicit trusted HTTPS origin/TLS and paired credentials. No listener activation in this patch.
pairing.output_admission: Session output_profile_id must be a currently admitted profile and geometry.canvas must match exactly. Profile governs max inputs/geometry modes. Examples are synthetic, not operational capability.

transport.authentication: Exactly one Authorization: Bearer header; server derives principal and allowed native installation from its paired credential record. No owner or permission field in request JSON.
transport.tls: Verified HTTPS exact paired origin; native HTTP allowed only explicit isolated loopback fixtures.
transport.origin: Browser requests require an exact allowed Origin; native service requests may omit Origin. Origin is never identity. Reject duplicates and invalid present Origin.
transport.request_id: X-Request-Id mandatory for mutations; key scoped authenticated principal + installation + credential revision + server epoch + session + endpoint. Same ID with different exact body conflicts. Reauthorize current principal/session/source permission before any cached secrets. No replay after revocation/expiry.
transport.hmac_token_grammar: 32 lowercase hexadecimal nonce characters, one dot, 64 lowercase hexadecimal HMAC characters; exactly 97 characters

identity.favorite_sha256: Lowercase SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical normalized JSON {locator,origin}, matching existing native SHA helper. Excludes title and receiver UUID. It is matching metadata, never source authority. Old removal-ledger/FNV hashes are not this digest.
identity.sources: Server-owned profile UUID/config revision plus explicit source/network policy and exact item revision. No root aliases, title or hash auto-enrollment. Unknown protection fails closed under applicable local policy.

rules: Nonzero capability requires qualified output_profiles with profile_id, canvas(width,height,fps), max_inputs, geometry_modes(disjoint|pip). Native computes exact pixels once on selected admitted raster. No memory budget escalation from requests. Empty while max_inputs=0.

endpoints.response: StatusResponse (same closed schema as /status). Server allocates session/backend identity; caller must not invent prior backend CAS.
rules: Geometry mode disjoint|pip; exact native canvas and rectangles validated server-side. No listener/decoder admission until qualified. Initial accepted creation does not imply Ready.

Owner authenticated read without prior backend revision; snapshot not execution permission. native_expected returns the stored authoritative binding for the requested immutable native identity. Session state preparing|ready|closing|closed|failed; slot state empty|preparing|playing|stalled|closing|closed|failed. Playing requires actual decoded frame; Ready requires actual output HLS frames. Audio is configured owner/policy, not proof of audible sound. Slot source_revision is backend revision used for next backend_slot_revision CAS.

Owner-bound recovery checks immutable native runtime/scene/slot and returns authoritative mutable revisions. Do not require stale source/layout/focus/audio tokens to match after a lost transition response.

Remaining budget narrows 30s cap; server monotonic receipt deadline, not client wall-clock. All CAS/source permissions before any DNS/open/probe/create. One redemption only. Reauthorize at redemption and publication.

Optional next_native is an atomic source-only intent transition from the full prior context. The returned context is the exact one-use grant binding. Cache publication failure leaves prior state unchanged. Changed intent is refused while the target has an outstanding grant or lease.

Closed operation union. Focus/audio-slot use context slot. Create and status have separate endpoints to avoid bootstrap/stale-CAS deadlock. Accepted/preparing never means decoded. Public controller semantics unaffected. Production create/play denied until decoder/output gate qualified.

Optional next_native follows the operation-specific native_transitions allowlist. Play uses the returned grant context with no second transition. Focus/audio/layout publish backend and native revisions atomically; no probe, network I/O or worker joining under that barrier.

endpoints.authentication: Path contains dedicated opaque media-only HMAC lease, not a control/provider credential. HMAC plus server-held lease binds epoch/session/output generation/absolute expiry. Every resource and every body chunk checks current authority/revocation/expiry.
rules: All manifest children resolve under exact paired origin and same signed lease prefix. No redirects, query-token dependency, media-read renewal, source URL/token leakage, or external children. HMAC path is secret: no-store/no-referrer/redacted logs. GET only; HEAD/Range denied until qualified. Serving permits held through body lifetime; revocation checked per chunk.

lifecycle.input_grant: min(receipt remaining_budget_ms,30000ms), one use, independent of playback
lifecycle.active_lease: 90s monotonic renewable only by currently authorized owner; recommended heartbeat30s; media reads never renew
lifecycle.hard_custody_ceiling: Separate operator configured absolute bound. Decoder static expiry must not use redemption30s or rolling90s. No implicit infinity.
lifecycle.active_invalidation: Favorite removal/re-add, attachment remap, parental/kiosk/credential/profile/policy/source revision change revoke pending and active. Native sends immediate stop/off on invalidation; server independently invalidates own authority. Lost network expires owner lease.
lifecycle.publication: Source lease generation mutex covers exact bounded callback. No IO/join while held. Unrelated focus/layout/audio changes do not retire unchanged active source.
lifecycle.retirement: cancellation_requested is not retired. New conflicting attach waits for output_revoked AND worker_reaped proof; preserve uncertainty if cleanup fails.

production_gate: max_inputs=0 until server-owned enrollment + exact auth/source CAS + nested transport + decoder integration + lifecycle/revocation + native output authority + actual independent source E2E qualify. Finite fetch/parser tests do not establish live adapter or TV capacity.
amendment: Unreleased v1 explicit prior/next native transition, original grant binding, recovery and real HMAC path grammar. Public controller wire is unchanged; production admission remains disabled.

rules.native_identity: Existing sessions never change native runtime, native scene or slot_id. Opaque revision tokens are compared, never incremented by the server.
rules.grant: Optional next_native changes only slot_generation/source_revision on an empty target. Validate full prior context, catalog/source/protection, capacity and no target grant/lease before any transition. Commit the next context and one-use grant atomically; redemption requires that exact returned context.
rules.play: Play consumes the exact grant context; no second native transition. Occupied targets are unsupported in the initial fixture and fail before revoking the old source.
rules.focus: Only focus_revision may change; audio_revision may additionally change when the authoritative policy follows focus.
rules.layout: Only layout_revision may change; topology removal requiring further source/focus/audio transitions is unsupported in the initial fixture.
rules.stop: Only the target slot_generation/source_revision may change, after exact prior CAS. Revocation and confirmed cleanup are separate phases.
rules.renew_off: Renew accepts absent/equal next_native only. Off closes the session without rebinding native identity.
rules.replay: Retain original prior and committed context with the scoped body digest. Reauthenticate before replay; validate the recorded committed grant/source and original request, never re-execute the old transition or revive a consumed grant.
rules.recovery: Status authenticates owner/installation, server epoch/session, stable native runtime/scene and target slot; stale mutable revision tokens are allowed for recovery. Return stored current state without rebinding.
rules.readiness: Session Ready means actual closed composite HLS and may include slates. Slot Playing requires actual decoded frames. Post-revocation rearm requires qualified full audiovisual cleanliness; a video-only watermark is insufficient.

native_transitions.fixture_limits: Initial live fixture: one compositor, at most60s hard lifetime, no occupied-target replacement. Stop retires its source and withholds output until Off; ordinary stable Stop and security-specific fresh codec epochs are separate qualification work.
